description: Registered calls admit one schema-lifecycle job and return its job_id/status before declaration parsing or lifecycle effects. Diff a plugin's declared schema against the recorded ownership snapshot and apply the resulting DDL in one transaction. Adds new tables and columns; swaps indexes (drop-then-create on resolved physical names). Refuses table removal — operator must call uninstall_plugin_schema (logical) or purge_plugin_schema (destructive) for that. Refuses column type changes, with_history toggles, id_prefix changes (out of v1 scope).
embedding_description: Queue the complete schema lifecycle operation and read its exact job for the final outcome. Apply additive schema changes for an installed plugin namespace: new tables, added or removed columns, added or removed indexes. All DDL plus ownership-snapshot updates happen atomically in a single Postgres transaction.

result_processor_customizations.result_description: Queued ActionResult receipt with data.job_id and data.status; the exact job.result retains the complete original lifecycle response and job.error its typed failure.
result_processor_customizations.presentation_guidance: Admission confirms the job was persisted, not that the schema changed. Read service_interface::job_service::get_job by this exact id until terminal before using lifecycle status, tables or force results.
result_processor_customizations.output_action_guidance: Poll the exact job id. Preserve the existing force and ownership premises. Reconcile an uncertain outcome or lost volatile declaration without replaying schema effects.

error_processor_customizations.action_context: Diffs the declared schema for a plugin namespace against the recorded ownership snapshot and applies the additive DDL in one transaction.
error_processor_customizations.error_interpretation: ValueError: namespace not installed, or its tables are all uninstalled (status=inactive — call install_plugin_schema first to reactivate). NotImplementedError: declared shape requires a refused transition (table removal, column type change, check-constraint mutation, with_history toggle, id_prefix change). Postgres errors propagate from the transactional apply.
error_processor_customizations.recovery_guidance: For 'not installed': call install_plugin_schema first. For 'inactive': call install_plugin_schema to reactivate. For NotImplementedError on table removal: call uninstall_plugin_schema (preserves data) or purge_plugin_schema (destructive). For column type changes: drop and re-add the column manually.
